title: Tokens & NFTs on NEAR
description: Implement NEP-141 fungible tokens and NEP-171 NFT minting, then learn how a simple marketplace moves them.
prerequisites: NEAR Smart Contracts (collections, deposits, and deploying to testnet).
Web3 Fundamentals: the difference between fungible tokens and NFTs.
youWillBuild: A mental (and optional testnet) implementation of an FT and an NFT mint, plus a sketch of a marketplace buy flow using approvals or nft_transfer_call.
overview: This course is about NEAR token standards. You will implement NEP-141 with storage deposits, mint NEP-171 NFTs with metadata (including soulbound diplomas), and walk through how a marketplace settles a sale without taking custody of private keys.
